description: This file defines the routing module for handling CRUD operations related to LLM cost records within a Node.js Express application. It sets up REST API endpoints for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting LLM cost documents, with middleware enforcing authentication, tenant scoping, and tenant normalization. The router also includes Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handler for GET /api/llm-costs, returns a list of LLM cost records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination, applying tenant scope enforcement.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handler for GET /api/llm-costs/:id, retrieves a specific LLM cost record by ID within tenant scope.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handler for POST /api/llm-costs, creates a new LLM cost record scoped to the tenant.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handler for PUT /api/llm-costs/:id, updates an existing LLM cost record within tenant scope.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handler for DELETE /api/llm-costs/:id, deletes the specified LLM cost record within tenant scope.
